You can't open this cell without the password anyway, and I'm sure not going to give it to you. Now get out of here.|Jerrd Sonclim to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Jerrd Sonclim''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he was hired by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to guard a room in the Imperial Research Facility on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] known as [[The Warren (Dantooine)|The Warren]]. However, Sonclim was killed by an Imperial operative tasked with investigating illegal operations within the facility.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Jerrd Sonclim was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
